# Apex — The Exam OS

> A study system for competitive exams. Tells you what to work on today, schedules
> revision automatically, and ranks weak topics by what actually costs you marks.

## What Apex does

- One daily recommendation computed from your reviews, errors, and mocks
- Adaptive spaced-repetition scheduling for topics and mistakes
- Section-wise mock analysis with friction-weighted weak radar
- Local-first: your data stays on your device unless you opt into encrypted sync
